in_marathi.name: Jitesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jitesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jitesh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'jit' meaning victory and 'ish' meaning lord or bringer. The name is bestowed upon a child born to parents who have recently experienced a significant victory or triumph, or to one who is expected to bring success and prosperity to the family.
